---
title: "Box Office Numbers"
---

This site explores `films.csv`, a dataset of 104 well-known films released between 1980 and 2025.
For each film it records the budget, worldwide revenue, runtime and IMDb rating.
Figures are rounded and not adjusted for inflation.
